title: Nullscape Tech Compendium
subtitle: Class tricks, setups, and little things worth remembering.

techs.title: Diver Bhop
techs.summary: One of the most Integral Techs for Diver movement.

blocks.content:
This tech is really necessary for precise movement and Early game gift collection.
It's also really useful for surviving Kolona if you forgot your number!

You should also do this tech if you get [[icon:Ninja Belt]] as its fundamental for Late game gift collection (but be careful or you're gonna fly off...)

Prerequisites:
2 Hands (Optional)
A pulse (Optional)
Early game gift collection is going to be much harder without this tech because a simple dive will make you fly over most gifts!
You can also chain this tech!

Do a dive [[icon:Diver]]
Wait a tiny bit (or don't)
Jump

blocks.caption: This Should be roughly the timing for the bhop (Its really not too precise)

techs.title: Magnet Collection
techs.summary: Mostly for collecting gifts in Standard or Extreme

blocks.content:
This tech is REALLY good for Collecting gifts in Standard and Extreme Because it lets you avoid tripmines and collect gifts at the same time!

Fundamentally its just a dive that is slightly offset to the right or left of a gift lane so that you don't touch the tripmines, but your gift collection range is high enough that you still collect the gifts.

This tech SHOULD be done using a Diver Bhop!

Prerequisites:
Min. x1 [[icon:Gift Magnet]] or any item that grants gift collection range (ex. [[icon:Miniature Hourglass]])
[[icon:Ninja Belt]] (Optional)
This tech can be done using a regular Dive [[icon:Diver]] or a [[icon:Ninja Belt]] Dive

This is a Late Game (LVL 20+) Tech, You will need [[icon:Miniature Hourglass]] and [[icon:Double Jump]] for this.

This tech can be used to save yourself from falling into the void, or just in general go anywhere you want while having a bunch of i-frames
It's a very easy to learn Tech, and the way it works is just:

Jump
After reaching the Peak Height of the jump, Place your Statue
Teleport back as soon as you can, then Immediately jump

Why does this work?

Simply because you regenerate your Double jumps every time you go out of Spirit form!

This tech is the best way of traversing across the entire map in seconds
It's self explanitory, you just fling yourself across the map with your Alt-Ability.

But here's some tips:

Watch out as to not go too far into the Void, if you're in spirit form and touch the void you'll still die.
Watch your energy bar, if it runs out too early you might not expect it and panic, or simply get into a bad situation.

To do a slingshot, simply:

Press your Alt-Ability button somewhere on solid ground
Go far away into the opposite direction you want to go
Press your Ability button
Here's some quick tips for what spirit form is generally useful for!

This is a Really simple tech
Good for when the opportunity comes or when there's alot of PVP in the lobby you're in!

Whenever you hear a seamine go off close to you that is not yours, simply press your Ability button (Not your Alt-Ability Button, You will probably die)
Also make sure that when you do that you're not in Spirit form
This is especially useful if you have Barotrauma.

This isn't a necessary tech, but good to know!

You can place your statue on Seamines, since they are considered Solid ground.
So what does this mean?

It means you can easily place your Alt-Ability Statue on a seamine, Activate the seamine and quickly go to the opposite side of where you want to go which makes the seamine shoot you away from your statue quickly, then fling yourself!
Be careful here, this is mostly useable in casual since Seamines explode faster on higher difficulty modes.
